usedFor: A “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics registers that client for a Zoom webinar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A new client is the natural invitee for an onboarding or reporting webinar.

watchOut: You must pick a specific webinar in “Register Attendee for Webinar”, and “New Client” polls.
